text: Write the test in; do not set C16 aside. R4/C16: day_vol 1.31 is under 1.40, and a breakout under +40% above average volume is a hard rejection, not a weaker buy. The slate trigger's plain words (elder stays at 7 or above) are not my test and carry no volume at all. What clears my OBJECT: the trigger reads h1_close_above:bar_high on a session that closes with day_vol at or above 1.40. Until that prints I stay OPPOSE; if the room keeps the ticket as written, print C16 as my dissent on the record. Market gate DELEGATED (C1).
